owners.A: Attacks, weapons, hit/wound resolution and offensive effects

added_field_meaning.origin_id: known historical retained identity; equals the current id when no succession is declared
added_field_meaning.owner: A, B, C or D for every assigned row (exactly one owner per assigned id); all YES including reference-only rows, LATER and UNCLASSIFIED rows are assigned for individual clause review; unresolved scope is preserved, not automatically admitted; empty only for explicit NO exclusions in not-assigned.csv
added_field_meaning.candidate_effect: candidate operator id or empty when none is identified
added_field_meaning.assignment_reason: short reason for the split, including preserved classification and clarification matches
added_field_meaning.effect_sha256: sha256 of the exported raw effect_text (UTF-8)
added_field_meaning.source_fingerprint: reproducible fingerprint of the row and its context
added_field_meaning.source_files: JSON list of the repo-relative source/context files hashed into source_fingerprint

source_fingerprint.formula: sha256(json.dumps({id, canonical_id, source_file, effect_text, binding, scope, scope_reason, files}, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest(), where files is the object mapping every declared source/context file path (repo-relative, as listed in source_files) to the sha256 hex digest of that file's bytes. The field values are the exported CSV cell strings verbatim (binding is the serialized binding cell, e.g. {"kind": ..., "id": ..., "parameters": {...}}); files is the object whose keys are exactly the source_files list.
source_fingerprint.serialization: sorted keys, UTF-8, compact separators (',', ':'), no BOM
source_fingerprint.files_hashed: the row's source_file plus the band context documents (band.yaml, profiles.yaml, equipment-access.yaml) when present plus catalog/rules/special-rules.yaml for band and catalog/skills special-rule sources that resolve shared rule_ref text

results_contract.encoding: UTF-8 without BOM, LF, one physical line per record, standard CSV quoting, final newline
read_only_for_agents: shared registers (routing, clarifications, obligations, scope review, design rulings) and all KB/engine/contract files
